description.en: Activates (or repositions) a flipper hazard registered with CMND_BTL_REG_FLIPPER, setting its position, rotation and optionally an extra direction vector.
Handle of the flipper slot, from CMND_BTL_REG_FLIPPER.
True once the flipper has been activated/repositioned; null if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Activate a registered flipper hazard at a specific position and rotation
CMND_BTL_ACTIVE_FLIPPER(hFlipper[0], 93, 200, -50.0, vec);
